name: Boat / RV storage
summary: Fenced, paved lots of 7–10 acres with a mix of open, canopy-covered (three- or four-sided) and fully enclosed 12–14 ft wide × 35–50 ft deep spaces; building coverage only 35–45% because of wide drive aisles. Cost per space is driven by the covered/enclosed mix and paving spec. Evidence is trade-press supplier pricing per SF of canopy/enclosure (Inside Self Storage); the per-space total is a derived build-up and should be verified.

typicalSize.method: Typical 7–10 acre sites (e4) × ~25–40 spaces/acre (below) ≈ 175–400 spaces; widened for 4–5 acre infill and 12+ acre sites. Mid 250.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Covered/enclosed footprint per space: 12×35 = 420 SF to 14×45 = 630 SF; mid 12×40 = 480 SF (typical class-A canopy bay).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Coverage 35–45% (e4/e5) × 43,560 SF ÷ 480 SF/space ≈ 32–41 spaces/acre; less detention/landscape/office → 25–40, mid 33.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Bottom-up per space. Site: ~1,100 SF paved per space (43,560/33 spaces less 15% landscape/detention) = 122 SY × asphalt $45/SY (paving block; heavier base for RVs) ≈ $5.5k–$8.5k + grading/drainage $1.5k–$3k + fence/gate/lighting/security share $1k–$2k ≈ $8k–$13.5k (mid $10.5k). Structures: canopy ≥$36/SF turnkey (e1), mid $40 × 480 SF = $19.2k; enclosed ≥$56/SF (e2), mid $60 × 560 SF = $33.6k. Standard mix 60% canopy / 20% enclosed / 20% open: 10.5 + 0.6×19.2 + 0.2×33.6 ≈ $28.7k → mid $28k. Low $13k = mostly open paved with 30% canopy (8 + 0.3×17.3). High $45k = 60% enclosed/40% canopy with concrete aisles (13.5 + 0.6×36 + 0.4×21). Supplier figures are 2025 and paving block 2026 (≤1 year gap) → stated in 2026 dollars without escalation.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit ÷ covered SF per space (13,000/440 ≈ $30, 28,000/480 ≈ $58, 45,000/600 = $75); this is per SF of covered/enclosed footprint and includes the paved site.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P; grading, paving of aisles and spaces, drainage/detention, perimeter fence and gate, lighting, canopies and enclosed units with doors, small office/kiosk. Excludes land, soft costs, off-sites, fees, solar, dump station and wash bays (optional lines).

qualityTiers.method: economy ≈ low/mid (13/28 = 0.46; open paved/gravel lot with some canopy); premium ≈ (mid+high)/2/mid for enclosed-heavy; luxury ≈ high/mid uplifted for condo-style units (>$72/SF, e3).

systemSplit.method: From the bottom-up mid: site ≈ $10.5k of $28k (31–33 ≈ 38% incl. fence in 32) and structures ≈ $18k (steel canopy/enclosed frames 05 22%, roof/wall panels 07 5%, roll-up doors 08 5%, pier footings 03 6%), lighting/electrical 5%, security 3%, GC 8%. Judgment.

lineItems.name: Steel RV/boat canopy (turnkey, per SF of canopy)

cost.method: Turnkey canopy "at least $36" per SF (e1) → low $36; mid $40 and high $50 add three-sided walls (+$3–$5/SF per e1) and taller/longer bays (judgment). Quantity: 60% of spaces × 480 SF = 288 SF per space.

lineItems.name: Fully enclosed RV/boat units incl. doors (per SF)

cost.method: Enclosed "at least $56" per SF incl. door packages (e2); high $72 = condo-style threshold (e3). Quantity: 20% of spaces × 560 SF = 112 SF per space.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out; raise the share for enclosed-heavy projects.

lineItems.name: Monitored security system (cameras, access control, alarms)

cost.method: Operator anecdote: a $50,000 monitored system after repeated break-ins (e6) = mid; range by site size (judgment).

lineItems.name: Solar PV on canopies (optional)

cost.method: From _blocks/energy.json carport-solar ($2,600/$3,200/$4,300 per kW, 2026). Quantity ≈ 288 SF canopy per space × ~14 W/SF ≈ 4 kW per space (judgment).

lineItems.notes: Optional revenue add; canopies may need structural upgrade.

lineItems.name: RV dump station and wash bay (optional)

cost.method: No source fetched. Dump station (holding tank/sewer tie-in, pad) $15k–$50k plus a covered wash bay with water reclaim $25k–$150k (judgment).

lineItems.notes: Optional amenity common in class-A facilities.

pctOfHard.method: Simple site-plan and pre-engineered canopy permits; civil engineering, survey, geotech, permits and lease-up marketing ≈ 8–16% of hard cost (judgment, below self-storage 15–28%).

perPrimaryUnit.method: min ≈ gravel/asphalt open lot with minimal canopy; max ≈ enclosed/condo-heavy facility at high × 1.3.
